gates.applicable_scope: Same-source reconstruction, H2.65 m and original image proportions; does not authorize changing shape.
gates.closing_condition: Restore local armor/vent/palm/foot features against the sole reference and inspect same-source views; present major conflicts and smallest shape proposal before any major change.

gates.applicable_scope: Neutral complete-module exclusive-space hypotheses: 25 certified drive-envelope overlaps, including 23 same-anchor pairs. Actual material/cavity/assembly/sweep remain unverified.
gates.closing_condition: Separate complete modules; close bearing, brake, cooling, cable, fastener/tool access and full motion paths within exterior envelope.

gates.applicable_scope: 890.757 kg estimated candidate; explicit thin skins and component masses; +/- component assumptions only. Compiled tensor readback passed.
gates.closing_condition: Identify real moving parts and parent/child drive allocation, rotor reflected inertia and credible component ranges; recompute full robot and perturbed loads.

gates.applicable_scope: 42 finite contact-static samples, virtual 0/10/20/40/60 kg loads and 20 kg mass perturbations; no grasp or thermal acceptance.
gates.closing_condition: Pass empty and loaded support/handling cases with real complete-module continuous torque/speed at credible mass and contact conditions; then add dynamic margins.

gates.applicable_scope: Named load-chain and frame mass reserves only; earth weight about 8.74 kN, worst sample ankle-roll about 1.64 kN*m.
gates.closing_condition: Provide material, sections, bearings/flanges/fasteners, deflection, peak/fatigue proof over task load range with consistent mass and space.

gates.applicable_scope: CSG rated reducer values and QTR electromagnetic reference; total module cooling and duty cycle not verified.
gates.closing_condition: Same-workpoint motor/gear/driver supply, speed, continuous torque, loss and heat rejection over task cycle, including enclosed installation.

gates.applicable_scope: 32S LFP 60 Ah, 102.4 V nominal/116.8 V full; 8 kW continuous/20 kW peak budgets are requirements only.
gates.closing_condition: Close real pack/BMS/driver ratings at SOC/full-charge, wiring, fusing, disconnection, emergency stop, negative power absorption/dump energy and cooling.

gates.applicable_scope: Sparse body proxies and same-source compound hand contacts; wrist interface versus proxy overlap unresolved; low-reach and single-support reject.
gates.closing_condition: Use actual assembly clearances to distinguish intentional bearing interfaces and interference, then rerun full sampled/continuous self/world contact with no hidden support.

gates.applicable_scope: Unassisted free root, force-clamped native position hold; 2 ms and 20 ms MuJoCo each stopped after one integration due to contact penetration.
gates.closing_condition: Pass finite documented duration and perturbations under physical joint torque/speed/power limits; no welded root, compensation or contact suppression.

gates.applicable_scope: Main stereo and wrist mount sites/FOV hypotheses; no implemented camera/sensor or optical occlusion proof.
gates.closing_condition: Model actual lenses/working range, same-source visibility and near-field occlusion during manipulation; validate timing and observations without answer leakage.

gates.applicable_scope: Bevy/Rapier 50 Hz/20 ms/one integration target; MuJoCo diagnostic does not constitute game acceptance.
gates.closing_condition: Verify SI adapter and native free-root contact, actual two-hand pick/carry/place/release, locomotion and composed tasks/recovery; report repeated successes/failures/realtime.

gates.applicable_scope: Reducer SKUs exist; motor/support/brake/driver/cooling composite not procured or detailed. Related red gates remain blocking.
gates.closing_condition: Resolve exact parts/custom drawings and supply after complete module physical range, packing/load/thermal validation; yellow cannot approve physics.

gates.applicable_scope: Finger 16 N*m design requirement, pack and camera functional envelopes are unselected hypotheses. Related red gates remain blocking.
gates.closing_condition: Resolve exact or custom part identities with size/mass/output/thermal range; separately pass structure, grasp, power and sensing red gates.

rule: Supply uncertainty may be yellow only; unknown or failed physical conditions block the corresponding stage.
